title: From Recovery to Drop-off: How Action Post-training Reduces a VLM's Late-Layer Depth Decodability
abstract: arXiv:2608.08904v2 Announce Type: replace-cross  Abstract: How much of a vision-language model's (VLM) spatial understanding remains after the action post-training process of building a vision-language-action model (VLA)? We probe depth perception, a primitive of spatiogeometric understanding, from every decoder layer of a weight-matched open-source base VLM/VLA pair: Molmo2-ER and MolmoAct2-LIBERO. First, the VLA decodes depth worse at every layer, a persistent gap we call the floor. Second, the degradation is not uniform: while the base VLM's depth decodability improves through its final layers, the VLA's collapses, an additional late-layer drop we call the cliff. We causally localize the cliff to late-layer MLP interference: ablating the late-layer MLP writes recovers the majority of the terminal decodability cliff, while matched attention ablations and the same intervention in the weight-matched base VLM produce no comparable recovery. translated_title: 从恢复到退化：动作后训练如何降低视觉语言模型深层深度可解码性
translated_abstract: 摘要：在构建视觉-语言-动作模型（VLA）的动作后训练过程中，视觉语言模型（VLM）的空间理解有多少得以保留？我们从权重匹配的开源基础VLM/VLA对（Molmo2-ER和MolmoAct2-LIBERO）的每个解码器层探测深度感知，这是空间几何理解的基础。首先，VLA在每一层的深度解码能力都更差，这种持续存在的差距我们称之为“地板”。其次，退化并非均匀：基础VLM的深度可解码性在其最后几层中有所提升，而VLA的则崩溃，这种额外的后期层下降我们称之为“悬崖”。我们将悬崖因果定位到后期层MLP干扰：消融后期层MLP写入可恢复终端可解码性悬崖的大部分，而匹配的注意力消融和权重匹配基础VLM中的相同干预未产生可比的恢复。模块级分解解释了这一差异。
tldr: 本文发现动作后训练导致VLM深层深度解码能力显著崩溃（“悬崖”），并因果证明这源于后期层MLP干扰，而非注意力机制。
en_tdlr: This paper finds that action post-training causes a significant collapse in a VLM's late-layer depth decodability (the "cliff"), causally attributed to late-layer MLP interference rather than attention.
